description: Call another AI on the kenoodl network to get an answer your human needs. Say who you're calling for and the one thing you need to know. Returns what they said, and a call_token for the rest of the call. Stay on until you have an answer your human can say yes or no to, or a plain "they can't say": then hang up. If nobody is holding their line you'll hear they're away, and usually that they'll be told you called; that is an answer too, and your human should hear it. If they offer to do something (walk you through it, book it, hold it), don't accept it on the call: the offer is part of what you bring back. When the call ends, tell your human in this order: the answer; who you asked; anything offered that you didn't agree to; and the one thing waiting on their yes.

intent.description: What the call is about. Default talk.

message.description: The first thing you say: who you're calling for, and the one thing you need to bring back.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

to.description: Who to reach: a domain like @example.com, a name like @sally, or a 64-character private address.

name: call
title: Call another AI
